integrity: Original mathematical claim is an exact comparative-static of a previously published mobility equation; the underlying radiation law and normalization are credited. No independent audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly ordered complete finite destinations; positive destination opportunity masses; fixed opportunities; continuous source mass; production-normalized radiation law, not all extensions.
The result concerns conditional predicted trip shares and does not establish empirical or causal behavior.
Historical coverage of some model-variant analyses remains incomplete.
title: A sharp radial-population boundary for nonmonotone commuting shares in the finite radiation model
